query: For my 56-year-old male patient, what is the 25th percentile of distinct ECG/telemetry procedures per patient among males 51–61?
final_sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.25) within GROUP (ORDER BY num_procedures) AS percentile FROM male_procedures WHERE subject_id IN (SELECT subject_id FROM male_patients);
